description: CI affected target policy. A project under targets.<target>.knownUnstableProjects runs that target as a warning instead of a gate on the affected lane. Every entry is tracked debt and carries {owner, reason, expires_on, finding_id} — the shape tests/invariants/invariant-reachability.dormant.json uses; scripts/ci/write-affected-target-report.mjs refuses the file when an entry is malformed and gates the project of an expired entry strictly (scripts/ci/lib/affected-target-policy.mjs), and tests/invariants/affected-target-quarantine-ssot.spec.ts ratchets the test and lint quarantines downward. Lint entries are written only by node scripts/ci/lint-debt-measure.mjs --renew from scripts/ci/lint-debt-measurement.json: a project that measures clean leaves, a project with security-class lint is never renewed, and every other expiry is the bound its measured debt allows (at most 90 days).
